claim: The ecological-forward-test skill is complete enough to run ecological case generation, forward testing, failure summarizing, root-reason analysis, and continued improvement (surgical patch loop) across agent harnesses, without critical missing procedure.
charitable_rule_applied: Explicit step procedure + handoff is enough for a competent agent unless a primary procedure stage is missing. Optional conventions (default folder names, fixed score-store layout, sandbox recipes) are not critical if the agent can choose. Quality depth extras (negative matrices, write-safety checklists, extra human gates) are polish/risk, not blocking loop procedure.

criteria.text: Ecological case generation is defined and required as the primary suite (not lab-only explicit $skill prompts).
evidence: SKILL.md §2: ecological case = session-like next turn; Do/Do not table bans single-shot Use $skill as main suite.
SKILL.md §2 Done when: ≥1 positive ecological + ≥1 negative; lab/explicit invoke optional control only, never primary suite.
SKILL.md Hard gates: Primary evidence = ecological/session-like, not easy explicit $skill lab prompts.
references/ecological-cases.md: Lab vs Ecological; lab never alone proves auto-invoke.
criteria.reasoning: Unchanged from iteration 1. Definition, primary-suite obligation, and lab demotion are explicit and repeated. Negative minimum satisfies generation requirement; depth is not c1.

SKILL.md Hard gates: Forward integrity = no gold leakage into runner prompt.
references/ecological-cases.md: Gold only in meta score sheet (not in prompt).
criteria.reasoning: Criterion text names three integrity pillars; all three are stated. Side-effect isolation and write safety are outside c2 as written (aligned with audit3’s own split). Mild path+task vs ecological tension is wording, not missing integrity rule.

references/failure-labels.md: five quality tests, good/bad examples, required pairing with what_happened.
criteria.reasoning: Rules are enumerable, example-backed, and checkable via reader test. No change from iteration 1.

criteria.text: No critical operational gap remains for a competent agent to finish a full loop (cases → score → label → root → patch → re-run → handoff).
evidence: SKILL.md steps 1–6 ordered: capture → ecological cases → forward test/score → failure labels → root reason → surgical patch + re-run same cases + stop when ecological positives and negatives pass.

Per-stage Done when: §1 miss listed; §2 cases written; §3 baseline scores for every case; §4 every fail labeled; §5 primary root + file to patch; §6 ecological pass + handoff of files patched + remaining risk.

Scoring ops: §3 record pass/fail per gold observable, session/run id, artifacts paths; gold_observables shape in ecological-cases.md; Improvement claim hard gate requires re-run of same ecological probes.
Handoff template: miss_id, callee/caller, cases, baseline, root reason, patch layer, will change/will not, patch, re-run, remaining — durable enough narrative comparison artifact for the next agent.
root-reason.md Before/after checklist + When to stop (ecological positives/negatives, remaining risk, surgical scope).
Case fields include setup/probe/gold/precondition/harness so packaging and scoring criteria are chosen in the case, not invented mid-loop.
criteria.reasoning:
FOCUS (re-audit vs audit3 fail). Under the charitable rule, c7 asks whether any *primary* loop stage is missing such that a competent agent cannot finish cases → score → label → root → patch → re-run → handoff. All seven stages have explicit procedure, Done-when, and supporting references. Residual audit3 issues are either optional conventions (where to put files), risk hygiene (isolation/write safety), quality depth (negative matrix), or wording slips (patch vs will_change)—none omit a stage or force the agent to invent the method.

Accept/reject of audit3 c7 points:
1) Score store path — REJECT as critical. Skill requires recording baseline scores, gold off-prompt in a meta score sheet, artifact paths, and handoff baseline/re-run lines. It does not mandate a fixed relative layout. Default folder names are optional conventions; agent may choose paths. Primary scoring procedure is present.
2) Side-effect isolation — REJECT as critical. Fresh thread per case is specified. Cross-case FS pollution is a real risk when gold mentions writes, but setup/gold live in the case record and a competent agent can choose disposable/realistic fixtures and score must-not-write. Isolation recipes are ops polish, not a missing loop stage.
3) Write safety procedure — REJECT as critical. Claim is completeness of the eval/improve loop, not a sandbox product. No dry-run/temp-cwd/forbid-list is a hygiene gap, not absence of cases→…→handoff procedure.
4) Human gates only for redesign — REJECT as critical. Human OK on redesign/scope expansion is stated; requiring human checkpoint before every baseline→patch or write-capable re-run is extra policy, not a missing primary procedure for finishing the loop.
5) Caller/callee binary / mono-skill — REJECT as critical for c7. §1 says callee/caller if split; §5 Done-when links root to skill file to patch; mono-skill → that one file with one concern per loop. Enum force-fit is usability, not a blocked loop.
6) Negative depth — REJECT as critical. ≥1 negative is the written minimum; false-trigger/no-write matrices improve suite quality but are not required for operational closure of one loop.
7) Handoff wording (patch: vs will_change allowlist) — ACCEPT as real defect; REJECT as critical/blocking. §6 table says touch only files in handoff patch: list while template defines patch: as files actually touched and will change as pre-edit intent. root-reason.md still requires file list up front and will change/will not before edit. Competent agent pre-binds will_change and records patch after. Naming slip does not remove the loop.
8) Lab path tension (§3 path+task vs ecological primary) — REJECT as critical. §3 offers path+task *or* natural multi-turn resume; hard gate and §2 keep ecological primary. Competent agent following hard gates will not treat lab path-invoke as primary evidence.

Net: no critical operational gap for the claimed full loop. Prior audit2 pass stands; confidence slightly adjusted after engaging audit3 (0.82→0.84) because the primary-stage test is clearer under the charitable rule, while residual polish gaps remain noted.
counterevidence: No prescribed default paths/formats for case fixtures or score sheets beyond field lists, record requirements, and handoff (agent must choose).
No explicit workspace isolation/restore/cleanup for write-capable gold observables.
§6 Allowed row references handoff patch: as pre-edit allowlist while template uses patch: post-edit — naming inconsistency.
No formal rule whether case pass requires all gold_observables vs partial (per-observable pass/fail only).
No end-to-end filled example artifact set (case + scores + handoff).

disputed_points_if_any.point: c7 critical operational gap (audit3 fail vs audit1/audit2 pass)
disputed_points_if_any.position: Under charitable rule, primary procedure for every loop stage exists; audit3 elevated optional conventions (score path, isolation, write safety, human gates, negative depth) and non-blocking wording (handoff allowlist name, mono-skill enum, path+task tension) to BLOCKING. Those are residual risk/polish, not missing primary procedure.
